implementation_strategy: Pilot (30 deterministic tasks) to validate parser/verifier mappings, then confirmatory paired run on 150 tasks. Use hosted model API (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini) for all LLM calls. Run Batfish and vendor-CLI parser emulation inside Docker containers (no Kubernetes). For each task: single shared initial generation, then at most one guarded repair call per adapter contract. All scoring, contamination detection, and exclusion logic automated and deterministic.
public_resources: Docker Hub public router images used for emulation (public Docker images)
OpenAI API docs (openai_responses) — hosted API access
task_manifest_strategy: Use the CNSM-AI-NetOps-Intent-Bench-v1 synthetic intent generator to produce 150 confirmatory intents stratified equally across three ambiguity strata (50 benign / 50 ambiguous / 50 partially-specified). Pilot of 30 tasks (pre-confirmatory) generated deterministically with fixed RNG seed and validated before confirmatory execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: single-shot intent→configuration generation (direct_configuration_generation_v1). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 — run LLM candidate, vendor-CLI syntax parser emulation (automatic rejection on parse failure), Batfish snapshot semantic checks for declared invariants; if verifier-fail, attempt one automatic repair generation; in rollback arm a staged canary enactment and automated rollback generation per preregistration mapping.
execution_batches: pilot: 30 tasks (pre-confirmatory validation of mappings and harness)
confirmatory: 150 tasks × 2 episodes (baseline and guarded) = 300 episodes
randomisation_plan: Deterministic stratified sampling with fixed RNG seed for intent selection and deterministic batch ordering. Within each ambiguity stratum tasks are randomly ordered using the fixed seed to ensure reproducibility.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses, Batfish snapshots, parser outputs, and verification results keyed by task hash to avoid redundant model calls and replays. Cache eviction not required during the 7-day wall-clock execution window.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated retry policy: up to 3 retries per transient provider/infrastructure failure with exponential backoff. If LLM/provider and secondary fallback fail after retries, mark task as 'infrastructure-missing' per preregistration. If infrastructure-missing ≤5% confirmatory tasks, exclude deterministically and run primary analysis; otherwise report sensitivity analyses (best/worst-case imputations). No human intervention permitted.
result_schema: JSON lines per episode following paired_binary_episode_v1: {task_id, stratum, condition, episode_index, initial_generation, initial_generation_hash, parser_status, verifier_status, verifier_queries, verifier_failures, repair_generation (if any), repair_hash, staged_canary_result, enacted_safe (boolean), unsafe_enactment_flag (boolean), time_to_detect_seconds, time_to_rollback_seconds, contamination_flags, notes}. Deterministic scorers compute binary unsafe_enactment per preregistered invariants.
estimated_compute_notes: Confirmatory run: 150 tasks × up to 2 LLM calls = max 300 hosted API calls (adapter maximum). Estimated_model_calls=225 assumes ~50% of tasks require a guarded repair. All Batfish verification and parser emulation executed in Docker on CPU-only hosts; each Batfish snapshot verification expected median ≈10s; total CPU wall time for verification estimated ≈ (number_of_verifications × median_time). Total hosted-model calls (≤300) well under manifest cap (10,000). Entire run planned to complete within 7 wall-clock days.
